title.zh: 查询标签支持的资源类型和标签能力项

descriptions.zh:
### 调用示例

- 查询TagResources或UntagResources支持的资源类型列表，请参见<props="china">[调用示例](https://api.aliyun.com/api/Tag/2018-08-28/ListSupportResourceTypes?tab=DEBUG&params={%22RegionId%22:%22cn-hangzhou%22,%22SupportCode%22:%22TAG_CONSOLE_SUPPORT%22})</props><props="intl">[调用示例](https://api.alibabacloud.com/api/Tag/2018-08-28/ListSupportResourceTypes?tab=DEBUG&params={%22RegionId%22:%22cn-hangzhou%22,%22SupportCode%22:%22TAG_CONSOLE_SUPPORT%22})</props>。

- 查询ListTagResources或ListResourcesByTag等查询类接口支持的资源类型列表，请参见<props="china">[调用示例](https://api.aliyun.com/api/Tag/2018-08-28/ListSupportResourceTypes?tab=DEBUG&params={%22RegionId%22:%22cn-hangzhou%22})</props><props="intl">[调用示例](https://api.alibabacloud.com/api/Tag/2018-08-28/ListSupportResourceTypes?tab=DEBUG&params={%22RegionId%22:%22cn-hangzhou%22})</props>。

- 查询支持创建者标签的资源类型列表，请参见<props="china">[调用示例](https://api.aliyun.com/api/Tag/2018-08-28/ListSupportResourceTypes?tab=DEBUG&params={%22RegionId%22:%22cn-hangzhou%22,%22SupportCode%22:%22CREATED_BY_TAG_CONSOLE_SUPPORT%22})</props><props="intl">[调用示例](https://api.alibabacloud.com/api/Tag/2018-08-28/ListSupportResourceTypes?tab=DEBUG&params={%22RegionId%22:%22cn-hangzhou%22,%22SupportCode%22:%22CREATED_BY_TAG_CONSOLE_SUPPORT%22})</props>。
descriptions.en:
### [](#)Call example

*   Query a list of resource types supported by TagResources or UntagResources. For more information, see [Example](https://api.alibabacloud.com/api/Tag/2018-08-28/ListSupportResourceTypes?tab=DEBUG\&params=%7B%22RegionId%22:%22cn-hangzhou%22,%22SupportCode%22:%22TAG_CONSOLE_SUPPORT%22%7D).
*   Query a list of resource types supported by ListTagResources or ListResourcesByTag. For more information, see [Example](https://api.alibabacloud.com/api/Tag/2018-08-28/ListSupportResourceTypes?tab=DEBUG\&params=%7B%22RegionId%22:%22cn-hangzhou%22%7D).
*   Query a list of resource types that support createdby tags. For more information, see [Example](https://api.alibabacloud.com/api/Tag/2018-08-28/ListSupportResourceTypes?tab=DEBUG\&params=%7B%22RegionId%22:%22cn-hangzhou%22,%22SupportCode%22:%22CREATED_BY_TAG_CONSOLE_SUPPORT%22%7D).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun tag list-support-resource-types --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-result 50 --next-token AAAAAYws9fJ0Ur4MGm/5OkDoW/Y3wDNwUdssyKODK+myOlBL --product-code ecs --resource-tye instance --show-items false --support-code TAG_CONSOLE_SUPPORT --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun tag ListSupportResourceTypes --region cn-hangzhou --MaxResult 50 --NextToken 'AAAAAYws9fJ0Ur4MGm/5OkDoW/Y3wDNwUdssyKODK+myOlBL' --ProductCode ecs --SupportCode TAG_CONSOLE_SUPPORT --ShowItems false --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ResourceTye instance
